intro.title: Your Privacy, Our Commitment
intro.message: Mirael is designed as a private, reflective space. We only collect what is strictly necessary to operate the service, and we never sell your data.
intro.note: Mirael is not a therapeutic relationship. If you are in crisis or at risk of harm, please seek immediate professional support.

principles.title: Key Principles
items: Minimal data collection – we only keep what is needed for your account and reflection history.
No advertising or data sales – your information is never shared for marketing.
Transparency – we explain clearly how and why data is used.
Safety first – emotional reflections are treated with heightened sensitivity.

rows: Enable sign-in and set your language

howWeUse.title: How We Use Your Data
paragraphs: Mirael processes your inputs in real time through GPT models. Responses are generated without retaining conversation history unless you choose to save reflections.
We use hosting, storage, and analytics providers only to run the service. These providers act as processors and cannot use your data for their own purposes.

yourRights.title: Your Rights
paragraphs: You can request access, correction, deletion, or export of your data at any time. Contact us at privacy@mirael.life.
If you are located in the EU/EEA or UK, you have GDPR rights. California residents also have rights under CCPA.

children.title: Children
children.note: Mirael is not directed to individuals under 18. We do not knowingly collect personal data from minors.
